title: Moldova voters choose pro-EU government over Moscow-leaning alliance – Europe live
summary: President Maia Sandu had accused Russia of using underhand tactics in attempt to sway voters European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen has also congratulated Moldova’s pro-European government on its re-election. “Moldova, you’ve done it again. No attempt to sow fear or division could break your resolve. You made your choice clear: Europe. Democracy. Freedom. Our door is open. And we will stand with you every step of the way. The future is yours.” “The people of Moldova have spoken and their message is loud and clear. title: AstraZeneca plans New York Stock Exchange listing but isn’t quitting London
summary: FTSE 100’s second-biggest firm will also retain HQ in Cambridge and maintain its London listing Business live – latest updates The drugmaker AstraZeneca is preparing to directly list its shares on the New York Stock Exchange, but said it will continue to be listed in London amid speculation over its future. The FTSE 100 company said its direct listing in New York will replace trading in its “American depositary receipts” (ADRs) – which give US investors exposure to a non-US company – on the Nasdaq.
